mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three-month RSAFS declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of four-month INDPRO increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index above 3% for six consecutive months signals persistent inflation, prompting tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, which in turn drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of six-month CPIAUCSL > 3% (t-test p > 0.05).
